overview: The biggest product news is Microsoft and NVIDIA launching a reworked Windows built around personal agents, and Coinbase bringing USDC to Samsung Wallet. Elon Musk spent the day promoting Grok Bot's new X search and bank-connection features and pushing Starlink in India and Bangladesh. Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, and Margaret Hamilton, who led the Apollo flight software, has died at 90. Much of the remaining volume was October 7 political content, which is skipped here.

top_items.title: Jensen Huang - NVIDIA and Microsoft unveil Windows 'reinvented for personal agents' after 4 years of joint engineering
Brian Armstrong - USDC is coming to Samsung Wallet as its first supported stablecoin, powered by Coinbase, soon in the US
Elon Musk - Grok Bot can now search, read and monitor X, and is being pitched as a bank-connected 'personal CFO'
Elon Musk - Starlink Mobile goes live in Bangladesh via Banglalink while Musk pushes hard for an India launch
Elon Musk - Endorses Paul Graham's view that Amazon banning agents opens the first real opening for an Amazon competitor
Demis Hassabis - Shares Sundar Pichai's launch of EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal model aimed at on-device efficiency
Yann LeCun - Shares a post saying Meta trained an 8B-parameter JEPA robot world model and found scaling laws
Jeff Dean - Pays tribute to Margaret Hamilton, MIT's Apollo flight software lead, who has died at 90
